name: Staff of Charming

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

magic.attunement: by a Bard, Cleric, Druid, Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard

powers.name: Shrug off an enchantment
powers.text: When you fail a save against an enchantment spell that targets only you, succeed instead (once per dawn; used automatically).

summary: 10 charges: Charm Person, Command, Comprehend Languages; it shrugs off enchantments aimed at you.
text: A magic Quarterstaff with 10 charges. Holding it, you can spend 1 charge to cast Command, Comprehend Languages or Charm Person with your spell save DC. When an enchantment spell aimed solely at you causes you to fail a saving throw while you hold the staff, you can turn the failure into a success; this can't be done again until the next dawn. And whenever you pass your save against such a spell, with or without the staff's help, you can use your Reaction and 1 charge to reflect it back at its caster as though you had cast it. Each dawn it regains 1d8 + 2 charges. Expending the final charge means rolling 1d20; on a 1, it turns into a nonmagical Quarterstaff.
